name: label
title: Label
description: Field and section labels with leading and trailing slots, required and optional marks, subtext, control inset alignment, and typography chrome.

api.description: Field and section label with leading and trailing slots, required and optional marks, subtext, control inset alignment, and typography chrome. Use as="label" with htmlFor for form controls. Use as="div" for section titles that share the same chrome.

groups.title: Label
groups.description: Root element, title content, and slots.

props.name: as
props.description: Root element. "label" associates with a control via htmlFor. "div" is for section titles such as SidebarGroupLabel.

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: Id of the labeled control. Applies when as is label.

props.name: children
props.description: Primary title content.

props.name: leading
props.description: Slot before the title text. Prefer FeaturedIcon plain at size md with glyphShadow off for a bare mark that matches the leading size token. Plain SVG icons still fit that token.

props.name: trailing
props.description: End-aligned slot on the title row. Pass Badge, a character count, an icon, or a control such as SidebarGroupAction.

props.name: subtext
props.description: Secondary supporting line under the title row.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the root.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles on the root. Can set --label-required and --df-label-* chrome vars.

groups.title: Inset
groups.description: Horizontal inset relative to a paired control. content uses --df-control-content-inset-inline, the same default as Input and Select content start.

props.name: insetAlign
props.description: left aligns to the control outer edge. content aligns to the default control content start (text, or a leading icon at that inset). custom uses insetSize.

props.name: insetSize
props.description: Required for a non-zero custom inset when insetAlign is custom. Prefer spacing tokens such as calc(5 * var(--spacing-unit)). Sets --df-label-inset-custom.

groups.title: Marks
groups.description: Decorative required and optional indicators after the title.

props.name: required
props.description: Shows a decorative required mark after the title. Wins over optional when both are set.

props.name: requiredVariant
props.description: Required mark style. "asterisk" renders the catalogue asterisk string as-is. "text" renders the catalogue required string as-is. Color uses --label-required.

props.name: requiredColor
props.description: Required mark color. Prefer tokens such as var(--destructive). Sets --label-required.

props.name: optional
props.description: Shows a decorative optional mark after the title. Ignored when required is true.

props.name: optionalVariant
props.description: Optional mark style. "text" renders the catalogue optional string as-is. "asterisk" renders the catalogue asterisk string as-is.

groups.title: Typography
groups.description: Title color and type. Prefer kit tokens for values.

props.name: color
props.description: Title color. Prefer tokens such as var(--muted-foreground). Sets --df-label-color.

props.name: fontFamily
props.description: Title font family. Sets --df-label-font.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Title font size. Sets --df-label-size.

props.name: fontWeight
props.description: Title font weight. Sets --df-label-weight.

groups.title: Parts
groups.description: DOM structure markers for styling and tests. These are not component props. data-df="label": Root element. data-inset is left, content, or custom. data-df="label-row": Title row with the title group and trailing slot. data-df="label-title": Title group: leading slot, title text, and required or optional mark. data-df="label-leading": Leading slot before the title text. data-df="label-text": Primary title text. data-df="label-required": Required mark. Uses --label-required. data-variant is asterisk or text. data-df="label-optional": Optional mark. data-variant is asterisk or text. data-df="label-trailing": Trailing slot on the title row for meta, icons, or controls. Uses --df-label-row-gap between multiple trailing children. data-df="label-subtext": Supporting line under the title row.

groups.title: Tokens
groups.description: Theme defaults live on :root. Override these globally or on a local host.

props.name: --df-label-gap
props.description: Stack gap between the title row and subtext.

props.name: --df-label-title-gap
props.description: Gap inside the title group between leading, title text, and marks.

props.name: --df-label-row-gap
props.description: Gap on the title row between the title group and trailing slot, and between multiple trailing children.

props.name: --df-label-leading-size
props.description: Default width and height for SVG icons in the leading slot.

props.name: --df-label-trailing-size
props.description: Default width and height for direct SVG icons in the trailing slot. Defaults to --df-label-leading-size.

props.name: --df-label-color
props.description: Title color. Falls back to --foreground. Override with color.

props.name: --df-label-font
props.description: Title font family. Override with fontFamily.

props.name: --df-label-size
props.description: Title font size. Falls back to --df-text-sm. Override with fontSize.

props.name: --df-label-weight
props.description: Title font weight. Falls back to medium. Override with fontWeight.

props.name: --df-label-inset
props.description: Horizontal inset applied as padding-inline-start. Resolved from insetAlign.

props.name: --df-label-inset-content
props.description: Inset used when insetAlign is content. Defaults to --df-control-content-inset-inline. Input and Select field roots may override this to track their content padding.

props.name: --df-label-inset-custom
props.description: Inset used when insetAlign is custom. Set by insetSize.

props.name: --df-control-content-inset-inline
props.description: Shared default control content-start inset. Owned in df-tokens.css. Input, Select, Combobox, and Label content mode consume it.

props.name: --foreground
props.description: Default title color when --df-label-color is unset.

props.name: --muted-foreground
props.description: Optional mark, subtext, and trailing color.

props.name: --label-required
props.description: Required mark color. Override globally or via requiredColor.

props.name: --destructive
props.description: Default source for --label-required.
